questions.text: What is the total order amount?
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM orders

questions.text: Which city has the most users?
questions.sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users GROUP BY city ORDER BY user_count DESC LIMIT 5
